## What is office space in ADGM?

Office space in ADGM is any workspace inside the Abu Dhabi Global Market jurisdiction, including Al Reem Island, that can be used as a company's registered address for an ADGM licence. It ranges from a flexi desk or dedicated desk in a serviced business centre to a fully furnished private office or a traditional office lease that the tenant fits out. Addax Tower is on Al Reem Island, so office space in Addax Tower is office space in ADGM.

---

## Office options and prices

### Dedicated Desk — AED 1,150 per month
Own permanent desk, registered ADGM business address, ADGM-compliant lease registered on AccessRP, 24/7 access, lockable storage, meeting room access. Leases 12–36 months. One-time AED 1,200 due-diligence fee; ADGM fees separate. Suits Tech Start-Up and most ADGM operating licences.
Page: https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/office-space

### Flexi Desk (Hot Desk) — AED 1,000 per month
Any open desk in the shared office, WiFi, coffee, print/scan, meeting room credits, no long-term commitment. No deposit, admin or setup fees. Suits individuals, remote teams, SPVs and holding companies.
Page: https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/office-space

### Private Office — from AED 4,500 per month
Fully furnished, lockable serviced office for 1–20+ people, reception, mail handling, cleaning, registered ADGM business address, 24/7 access. Suits FSRA-regulated firms and growing teams.
Page: https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/private-office

### Virtual Office — from AED 292 per month
Registered ADGM business address, mail handling and forwarding, company directory listing. Basic, Premium and Enterprise packages.
Page: https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/virtual-office

### Meeting Room — hourly
For client meetings, interviews and board meetings; open to members and non-members.
Page: https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/meeting-room

### Day Pass — AED 100 per day
9 AM–6 PM (AED 150 for 24 hours), no membership needed.
Page: https://www.aegiscoworking.ae/day-pass

## Serviced office vs traditional office lease in ADGM

| | Aegis serviced office | Traditional lease |
|---|---|---|
| Move-in time | Same week | Months of fit-out |
| Furniture & IT | Fully furnished, WiFi ready | Tenant buys and installs |
| Deposit & setup fees | None | Deposit + fit-out costs |
| Utilities, cleaning, reception | Included | Separate contracts |
| Lease length | 12–36 months, upgrade any time | Usually multi-year |
| ADGM paperwork | AccessRP lease handled | Tenant arranges |

---

## Which office does an ADGM licence need?

- SPV or holding company: flexi desk
- Tech Start-Up and most operating licences: dedicated desk
- FSRA-regulated activity: private office
- Registered address only: virtual office

Confirm final requirements with the ADGM Registration Authority or FSRA.

---

## Frequently asked questions

### How much does office space in ADGM cost?
At Aegis Coworking in Addax Tower: flexi desk AED 1,000/month, dedicated desk AED 1,150/month, private office from AED 4,500/month, virtual office from AED 292/month, day pass AED 100.

### Dedicated desk vs flexi desk in ADGM?
A dedicated desk is a permanent desk with a registered ADGM business address (AED 1,150/month). A flexi desk is any open desk (AED 1,000/month) for those without an ADGM licensing requirement.

### Can I register an ADGM company with this office space?
Yes. Dedicated desk, private office and virtual office include a registered ADGM business address, and the lease is registered on AccessRP.

### What is the due-diligence fee?
A one-time AED 1,200 fee covering ADGM compliance and background checks before the licence and registered address are activated.

### Serviced office vs traditional office in ADGM?
A traditional lease is an empty unit to fit out, usually with a deposit and multi-year term. A serviced office at Aegis is fully furnished with utilities, cleaning, reception and WiFi included.

### Is Addax Tower in ADGM?
Yes. Addax Tower is on Al Reem Island, part of the ADGM jurisdiction.
